5-Achs-Simultan: Kugel-, Schaft-, Torus-: 5-axis simultaneous: choose a ball, flat, bull nose or tapered end mill
5-Achs-Wälzfräsen: die Flanke des Fräser: 5-axis swarf milling: the flank of the cutter lies on the wall – finish drafted walls in one cut
Das Werkzeug neigt sich zur Flächennorma: The tool leans towards the surface normal.
Die Werkzeugachse zeigt immer durch den: The tool axis always points through the point: if it lies below the part, the tool fans out; if it lies above, the tool leans towards it.
Die Werkzeugachse zeigt immer durch die: The tool axis always points through the line – the tool only leans across it.
Das Werkzeug steht mit Voreil- und Seite: The tool keeps its lead and side tilt angle to the feed direction.
Die Flanke des Fräsers legt sich an die: The flank of the cutter lies on the wall beside the pass (draft taken from the model). For walls that open upwards; stepdown = height per cut.
Kugel-, Schaft-, Torus- oder Konusfräser: Ball, flat, bull nose or tapered end mill. A ball end mill keeps its path; other cutters are tilted and moved along their axis until they touch the part without gouging it. At most the largest tilt; where the shank or the holder would touch the part, the tool stands up again. Output as a tool vector (Heidenhain, Sinumerik, Fanuc), otherwise as a 3-axis path.
